long_biography.plain_text:
At RCB Bank, Kirill Zimarin combined executive leadership with a wider role in Cyprus's international-banking community. He joined the Limassol institution in 2005 and became chief executive three years later, leading it as it became a significant Cyprus lender. His work also included chairing the Association of International Banks in Cyprus and serving on a European Banking Federation group.

Zimarin's academic training ran alongside that career. He studied economics and international relations at Moscow State University, completing postgraduate research and later a higher doctorate in economics. When RCB withdrew from deposit-taking in 2022, management repaid deposits, sold loan portfolios and shifted the remaining assets into a regulated asset-management business. The successor, Finstella, later received a Cyprus credit-servicing licence.
